stories.title: Police officer guilty of raping woman
stories.summary: Avon and Somerset PC Stephen Phipps is convicted of rape and controlling and coercive behaviour.

stories.title: Man charged after teenager raped in city park
stories.summary: Bangally Gumanneh, from Bath, is charged with rape and sexual assault.

stories.title: Pontins fined £1m after grandmother's death
stories.summary: A grandmother died after a part of an air conditioning duct and ceiling collapsed onto guests.

stories.title: The Snowman Christmas trail unveiled
stories.summary: A trail that includes 12 sculptures from the children's book The Snowman is unveiled in Bath.

stories.title: Officers investigated after man dies in police chase
stories.summary: A man in his 70s died after a car that was being pursued by police hit him.

stories.title: Why are some hosepipe bans still in place?
stories.summary: Although the West has had rainfall recently, many supplies remain too low to lift restrictions.

stories.title: Graffiti from the past found during restoration
stories.summary: The graffiti dates back to 1780 and was found on one of the towers on Wells Vicars' Close.

stories.title: Woman drugged and advertised for sex by husband speaks out as abusers found guilty
stories.summary: Joanne Young said the actions of her husband over 13 years had "cost me my life as I knew it".

stories.title: Pontins put profits over safety before woman's death, court told
stories.summary: Grandmother Wendy Jones died six months after a ceiling collapse at Pontins' Brean Sands in Somerset.

stories.title: Nicholls sets record for jump winners by British trainer
stories.summary: Paul Nicholls surpasses Martin Pipe to set a new National Hunt record for winners by a British trainer.

stories.title: Volunteers launch £600k bid to buy 'vital' church
stories.summary: Newbridge Community Hub wants to buy Weston Methodist Church, which was listed for sale in August.

stories.title: Parking enforcement stepped up near airport
stories.summary: It is hoped this will help protect the environment and make life easier for residents.
